issue.title: Reject non-conventional commit subjects in sase commit
issue.description: `sase commit` refuses to create a commit, proposal, or pull request whose subject line is not a Conventional Commit, printing an actionable error that tells the agent exactly how to rewrite it, while staying lenient enough that legitimate subjects, merge/revert/fixup subjects, and projects that opt out are never blocked.

issue.title: Conventional-subject grammar in the Rust core
issue.description: core_grammar: add a pure `commit_subject` domain module to sase-core that parses a commit subject into type/scope/breaking/description, classifies exemptions, and reports a stable violation code; expose it through the `sase_core_py` binding.

issue.title: Python facade, policy config, and shared header helper
issue.description: python_surface: add the typed Python facade over the new binding, the `commit.message` configuration block with its schema and defaults, and retarget the existing init-memory conventional-header check at the shared helper.

issue.title: Reject invalid subjects in CommitWorkflow
issue.description: commit_enforcement: gate `CommitWorkflow.run()` on the subject policy before any side effect runs, render the actionable rejection message, record the telemetry reason, and update the existing tests that commit with non-conventional messages.

issue.title: Document the gate and guard against type-list drift
issue.description: docs_and_guidance: document the new configuration and the rejection behavior, mention the gate in the git commit skill, and add a regression test that keeps the repo's PR-title CI type list compatible with the validator defaults.

payload.entry: Landed sase-core commit d8cb1e2 on origin/master. Verified cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, Rust grammar cases, and the PyO3 binding round trip.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Cache agent-name registry state during bead association publication — the post-commit publication step repeatedly rescanned dismissed bundles per association record while holding the bead-store write lock, consuming high CPU for nearly seven minutes until stopped after durable commit and bead state were complete.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Fix reciprocal plan/prompt links for conventional_commit_subject_gate — `just check` currently fails in `plan links validate` because 202607/conventional_commit_subject_gate.md and 202607/prompts/conventional_commit_subject_gate.md are missing reciprocal prompt links.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Fix model completion catalog casing and affected ACE model-panel snapshots — `just test` fails in tests/test_xprompt_model_completion.py expecting `Codex (gpt53spark)` while code renders `codex (gpt53spark)`, with two related model-panel PNG snapshot mismatches.

Implemented commit subject facade/policy/config/schema/init-memory retarget. Verified: just install; focused Ruff and pytest for commit subject/message validation/init-memory; linked core cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace. just check passed lint stages but failed SASE validation on unrelated plan-link errors already noted. just test completed with 24728 passed, 7 skipped, and 3 unrelated model-panel failures already noted.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Avoid repeated agent-name registry source scans during committed bead page publication — `sase commit` created and pushed the main repo commit, then spent several minutes at 100% CPU rebuilding association links via `_source_signature()` before it had to be interrupted.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Repair the conventional-commit epic plan/prompt reciprocal link — `sase validate` reports missing `prompt` links between 202607/conventional_commit_subject_gate.md and 202607/prompts/conventional_commit_subject_gate.md, blocking `just check` after all lint stages pass.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Refresh config-center PNG visual snapshots for the new commit.message defaults — the full suite reports the config-center snapshot family changed after phase 2 added the default configuration block.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Reconcile Codex provider-label casing in model completion metadata/test — test_model_completion_catalog_reflects_real_builtin_model_metadata expects "Codex (gpt53spark)" but current catalog renders "codex (gpt53spark)".

Implemented the early Conventional Commit subject gate before cwd lookup and all mutable workflow steps; verified invalid_message telemetry, zero side-effect/provider calls on rejection, pass-through for all three methods, opt-out/exemption behavior, and empty-message rejection. Focused workflow coverage passed (63 tests), broad non-visual suite passed (24,384 passed, 7 skipped), git diff --check passed, all just check format/lint stages including Symvision passed, and real CLI smoke tests confirmed rejection output plus -M preservation/retry guidance. The remaining SASE plan-link validation, config-center PNG snapshot drift, and unrelated Codex label mismatch are recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP notes.

Documented commit.message in docs/configuration.md (new #### subsection + settings table, exempt prefixes, allowed_types-replaces-default, updated Source: line); documented the subject gate in docs/commit_workflows.md (added to the CommitWorkflow stage diagram before bead association, prose on ordering/reason=invalid_message/-M preservation, and the use_project_pr_prefix interaction); added the mandatory-tag note to src/sase/xprompts/skills/sase_git_commit.md step 2 and verified it renders for all 5 providers via .venv/bin/sase skill init --diff (deploy deferred until the change lands, per generated_skills). Added tests/test_pr_title_type_drift.py asserting every type in .github/workflows/pr-title.yml's allowed_types is a subset of default_commit_subject_types(), with a message naming the drifted type and both files to update; verified it fails as intended by injecting 'feet'. Also removed the now-stale --epic-symbol entries for closed bead sase-bj.3 from the Justfile and made CommitSubject/CommitMessagePolicy private (_-prefixed, matching commit_footer_facade) so symvision passes without a whitelist. just check: all fmt/lint stages green; just test shows only pre-existing failures (1 xprompt model-completion + 53 visual snapshots; 54 fail at baseline too). SASE validation's two failures (stale skill deploy, plan prompt-link) also reproduce on clean master — recorded as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs.

Land audit complete for convention-commit gate epic. Verified child phase beads are all closed and done: sase-bj.1 (core grammar + parser binding), sase-bj.2 (commit message facade/config/schema/shared header helper), sase-bj.3 (pre-side-effect subject gate + telemetry + exemptions), and sase-bj.4 (docs + PR-title type-drift test).
